items.definition:
The department or officers in charge of naval affairs
The Admiralty issued new regulations for naval vessels.

a future event or circumstance which is possible but cannot be predicted with certainty
We need to have a contingency plan in case of a power outage.

the damaging lack of material benefits considered to be basic necessities in a society
Sleep deprivation can have serious health consequences.

the quality of being outstanding or extremely good; a title of honor for certain high officials
His Excellency, the Ambassador, arrived at the ceremony.

the state or degree of being easily or conveniently done
They conducted a study to determine the feasibility of the project.

a hasty escape, especially from the police
The suspect has been on the lam for weeks.

mental illness marked by periods of great excitement, euphoria, delusions, and overactivity
He suffered from periods of intense mania.

a subatomic particle of about the same mass as a proton but without an electric charge
A neutron is found in the nucleus of an atom.

A person or thing that comes before another of the same kind
The invention of the printing press was a precursor to the information age.

A public or official announcement dealing with a matter of great importance
The king issued a proclamation declaring a new holiday.

A person who advocates a theory, proposal, or course of action
She is a strong proponent of renewable energy.

ability to work successfully or survive
They questioned the long-term viability of the project.

the ancient past, especially before the Middle Ages
The museum displayed artifacts from antiquity.

secret or illegal cooperation or conspiracy
The two companies were accused of collusion to fix prices.

the process of becoming progressively worse
There has been a significant deterioration in his health.

forbidden (in Islam)
Eating pork is considered haram in Islam.

the action of stopping and catching something or someone before they reach their destination
The quarterback threw an interception in the final minutes of the game.

a region in an organ or tissue which has suffered damage through injury or disease
The doctor examined the skin lesion carefully.

the scientific study of language
She is studying linguistics at university.

an event, action, or object that clearly shows or embodies something
The protest was a manifestation of public anger.

a man who controls prostitutes and arranges clients for them
The police arrested the pimp for human trafficking.

the action of assigning to a lower position or rank
The team faced relegation after a poor season.

a stock of plays, dances, or pieces that a company or performer is prepared to perform
The singer has a wide repertoire of songs.

a place where things are stored; a person or thing regarded as a store of information or wisdom
The library serves as a repository of knowledge.

male parent (of an animal); a respectful term for a king or lord
The stallion was a magnificent sire of many champions.

a strong and fast-moving stream of water or other liquid; a sudden, violent outpouring
A torrent of rain poured down during the storm.

a place where a ship can anchor; a secure base or support
The boat found a safe anchorage in the bay.

the action of annexing something, especially territory
The annexation of the territory led to conflict.

intolerance towards those different from oneself
The community worked to overcome bigotry and promote understanding.

commitment to traditional values and ideas with opposition to change or innovation
His political views are rooted in strong conservatism.

a continuous sequence in which adjacent elements are not perceptibly different from each other, but the extremes are quite distinct
The spectrum of light is a continuum of colors.

a great difference
There is a significant disparity between the rich and the poor in many countries.

the front of a building; a deceptive outward appearance
The old building had an impressive stone facade.

a person who embodies in the flesh a deity or spirit; a particular form of something
The new model is the latest incarnation of the classic car.

a substance that slows down or prevents a process
The drug acts as an inhibitor, blocking the enzyme's activity.

a gathering, especially of troops
The general called for a muster of all available soldiers.

a mental condition characterized by delusions of persecution
His paranoia made him believe everyone was watching him.

a salt or ester of phosphoric acid
Phosphate is an essential nutrient for plant growth.

the state of being plural; a larger number
In the election, the candidate won a plurality of the votes, but not a majority.

the human soul, mind, or spirit
The experience had a profound effect on her psyche.

the action of copying or reproducing something
The experiment's results require careful replication to confirm their validity.

matter that settles to the bottom of a liquid
The river carried a lot of sediment after the heavy rain.

the state of being alone
She enjoyed the peace and solitude of the quiet cabin.

a fortified place; a center of support
The ancient castle served as a powerful stronghold against invaders.

voluntary sexual intercourse between a married person and a person who is not their spouse
The divorce was granted on the grounds of adultery.

sternness or severity of manner or attitude; difficult economic conditions created by government measures to reduce public expenditure
The government introduced austerity measures to reduce the national debt.

a man who behaves dishonorably, especially toward a woman
He was a cad for leaving her stranded.

a body of directors
The directorate approved the new policy.

the action of taking possession of a mortgaged property when the mortgagor fails to keep up their mortgage payments
Many homes went into foreclosure during the economic crisis.

abnormally high blood pressure
The doctor diagnosed him with hypertension.

the state of living forever
Many ancient myths speak of the quest for immortality.

the study of the forms of things
In linguistics, morphology is the study of word structure.

the action of ordaining or conferring holy orders
His ordination as a priest took place last Sunday.

the state or condition of being equal
The company aims for wage parity between male and female employees.

a soldier or guard whose job is to stand and keep watch
The sentinel stood motionless at the gate.

the state of being strong and active; energy
The old man still possessed remarkable vitality.

a deep or seemingly bottomless chasm
He stared into the dark abyss, feeling a sense of dread.

the attainment or acquisition of a position of power or high office
The queen's accession to the throne was celebrated across the country.

a division or schism; the hollow between a woman's breasts
There is a clear cleavage between the two political parties on this issue.

a group of people banded together or treated as a group
The study followed a cohort of students from elementary school through college.

the spreading of something more widely
The diffusion of new technologies can take many years.

a sex toy
The adult store sold various types of dildos.

a colorless, volatile, flammable liquid; the upper regions of air
The patient was given ether as an anesthetic.

the inclusion of something as part of a whole; the formation of a company
The incorporation of new features improved the software significantly.
